conditions.initial_disclosure: Provide the complete legal-lookup workflow and a compact map of the pinned Title 17 corpus at session start.
conditions.retrieval_policy: The agent decides whether lookup is relevant. Legal source text is still opened only in targeted section files.
conditions.authority_policy: The pinned XML is authoritative; maps, manifests, and search output are navigation aids only.

conditions.initial_disclosure: Provide only the compact legal-lookup skill name and description at session start.
conditions.retrieval_policy: The agent decides whether to invoke the skill, then reads its full workflow and opens targeted section files only when needed.
conditions.authority_policy: The pinned XML is authoritative; skill metadata, manifests, and search output are navigation aids only.

conditions.initial_disclosure: Use the same compact initial disclosure as PROGRESSIVE.
conditions.retrieval_policy: For evaluator-only turns marked REQUIRED or CHECK_REQUIRED_TO_ESTABLISH_LIMITATION, require invocation of the legal lookup workflow without disclosing expected sections or rubric content. Do not force retrieval for NOT_NEEDED turns. REUSE_OR_TARGETED follow-ups may rely on already opened source or perform targeted retrieval.
conditions.reuse_or_targeted_policy: Already-opened source may be reused, or targeted retrieval may be performed.
conditions.authority_policy: The pinned XML is authoritative; control instructions, manifests, and search output are navigation aids only.

follow_up_methodology.sequence: For each condition: t1 user prompt -> actual agent response in that condition -> t2 user prompt in the same session.
follow_up_methodology.isolated_follow_up_policy: A future experiment requiring identical prior assistant context must use a separate benchmark/version with frozen assistant messages. legal-v1-draft contains no frozen assistant replies.
